purpose: Teach: 太る/引っかかる/ほた/スミマセン/ひねり/広々/昇っ/すれ違う

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、繁忙期で食べる時間も無いから、太るどころじゃないね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, during busy season you're too slammed to even eat—you're not gaining weight, you're just running on fumes.
lines.style: Light, teasing tone with an undercurrent of genuine concern. Warm delivery, slightly conspiratorial. Observing without judgment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のバッグが椅子に引っかかる事になりそうよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, customers' bags keep catching on the chairs back there—we should probably do something about that.
lines.style: Practical observation delivered gently. Noticing small problems others miss. Quiet, matter-of-fact, but not critical.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、「ほた、お客様が来た」って今日は聞こえたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I heard you calling out "a customer just came in" so many times today—it's kind of sweet how much you care.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate tone. Slight smile in the voice. Noticing something tender without making her self-conscious about it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様に「スミマセン」と謝る場面は、なるべく無いようにしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's try to avoid those moments where you're apologizing to customers, yeah? You're already too hard on yourself.
lines.style: Gentle direction with real care underneath. Not bossy. The tone of someone offering help, not giving orders. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューに、ひねりを加えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, what if we added a little twist to the new menu items? Something unexpected.
lines.style: Encouraging, collaborative tone. Inviting input, not dictating. Warm and energized. Building something together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新店舗は広々として、お客様にも好評ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new location turned out so spacious—customers are really responding well to it.
lines.style: Pleased and a little surprised by how well it's working. Quiet satisfaction. Noticing how the space itself is doing the work.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、二階に昇って下さるお客様も多いね、メイちゃん
lines.en: A lot of customers are actually heading upstairs too. That's good—it spreads things out.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly thoughtful. Observing a positive pattern without over-celebrating it. Calm, satisfied note.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様とすれ違う時、必ず会釈しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: When you pass customers in the aisles, make sure to bow—little acknowledgments matter.
lines.style: Clear, practical guidance delivered warmly. Not an order. The voice of someone who knows small courtesies build connection.
